opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not have held a full‑time permanent academic post, must hold a doctorate, must have submitted their thesis for viva by the closing date, must be resident in the UK and be a UK‑based researcher.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research, with salary support and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired researchers who live in the UK, have held a teaching/research post at a UK university or eligible independent research institute, and have an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired senior researchers to complete or publish research projects.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Research expenses up to £6,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be employed at an eligible UK university; must have a strong research record; previous holders are ineligible.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for well‑established researchers in humanities and social sciences to undertake original research, with salary costs funded and limited research‑expense funding.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent academic appointment (or nominated) at a UK university, and meeting career‑stage criteria.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build a research team and demonstrate research leadership over 4–5 years.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and other UK higher‑education institutions; trial basis independent research institutes eligible under UKRI criteria.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative original research projects, covering staff costs and associated research expenses, with up to five‑year duration.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (or specialist arts institutions) acting as host; applicant must be an eminent senior professor from overseas; visits of 3–12 months.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK institutions to invite eminent overseas scholars for visits that enhance skills and knowledge in under‑represented research areas.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Undergraduate & Postgraduate Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities (not individuals); institutions may apply for one award per round, maximum total award £475,000.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to support outstanding undergraduate and postgraduate students in fine and performing arts at eligible specialist institutions.
